Verify an API token by asserting the app and persona it belongs to.
operation.description: Verify an API token by asserting the app and persona it belongs to. The verification is a protection against client-side attacks and will fail if the contents of the token don't match the provided values. A token must be verified before it can be used to manipulate user tags.
